I want to re-test with two genuinely distinct calls, each carrying its own thinking, and also add the collapsing guideline to the system prompt this time, since the probe lacked it and that's likely why the model treated the collapsed echo line as self-authored text rather than a real prior call. For probe 3, I'll set up a two-step sequential task: call echo with 'a', then echo with 'b', each as its own assistant turn with distinct thinking, then collapse both into labels so there are three adjacent assistant turns with different thinking content, under the system prompt that includes the collapsing guideline, followed by a clarifying question.
